short: Federal Decree-Law 45 of 2021, personal data protection
covers: Processing of personal data by controllers and processors in the State, and outside it where data subjects are in the State (Art. 2(1)).
exclusions: Art. 2(2): (a) government data; (b) government entities that control or process personal data; (c) personal data held by security and judicial authorities; (d) personal use; (e) health data with its own legislation; (f) banking and credit data with its own legislation; (g) free-zone entities with their own data protection legislation. Art. 1 'establishment' includes companies wholly or partly owned by federal or local government.
relevance_to_j1: Scope finding case: the simulated entities are government entities, so on this reading the instrument does not apply to them, and Art. 18 (objection to automated decisions with legal or significant effect; human review on request, Art. 18(4)) reaches covered controllers only.
language_note: Official Arabic print edition only was reachable; the Arabic text layer has ligature-order defects, so no verified English quotation is possible. The official English text sits on a host that blocks automated clients; Walter downloads it in a browser.
evidence: V (Arabic text, article and paragraph letters read by the author on 2026-10-27)
reach_status: reading confirmed on the Arabic text; English wording not obtained

short: Federal Decree-Law 45 of 2021, personal data protection (official English text)
covers: Art. 2(1): "Provisions of this Decree by Law shall apply to the processing of all or part of the Personal Data by means of electronic systems which operate automatically, or by other means", by (a) each Data Subject residing in the State or having a place of business in it, (b) each Controller or Processor residing in the State, (c) each Controller or Processor outside the State processing data of Data Subjects inside it.
exclusions: Art. 2(2): "Provisions of this Decree by Law shall not apply to the following:" (a) "Government Data"; (b) "Governmental entities which control or process Personal Data."; (c) personal data held by the security and judicial authorities; (d) personal use; (e) health data with its own legislation; (f) banking and credit data with its own legislation; (g) free-zone companies with their own data protection legislation. Art. 1 'Establishment' includes "companies wholly owned by the federal or the local government, or in which they are shareholders".
relevance_to_j1: Scope finding case: the simulated entities are government entities, so under Art. 2(2)(b) the instrument does not apply to them; Art. 18 (objection to decisions resulting from automated processing; Art. 18(4) "The Controller shall include the human element in reviewing automated processing decisions at the request of the Data Subject.") reaches covered controllers only. Complaints to the Bureau (the UAE Data Office): Art. 24.
language_note: Official English text from the UAE Legislation portal; same instrument as U01 (Arabic print edition). Whether the Arabic prevails in a conflict is not stated in the English file.
evidence: V (English text, Articles 1, 2, 18 and 24 read by the agent on 2026-11-09)
reach_status: reading confirmed on the English text; matches the Arabic reading recorded for U01
